findings.title: Formal incoming usage DTO still rejects explicit unknown observations
evidence: docs/openapi-v1-planned.json:53673-53675 ExecutionReportedUsage.required still contains inputTokens and outputTokens
apps/api/src/runtime/execution-routes.ts:52 signed result Zod schema allows omitted token fields

findings.impact: The published incoming DTO remains incompatible with the unknown body produced by startup/recovery. The actual signed Zod route accepts that shape; this review does not claim that existing HTTP necessarily rejects it. The signed partial test has token numbers and cannot establish unknown DTO compatibility.
findings.narrowFix: Make ExecutionReportedUsage use the same optional token and explicit unknown semantics as ExecutionActualUsage, preserve this in the contract generator, then verify a no-token unknown body against the formal DTO and the real signed delivery/journal ACK path.

reviewedChanges.assessment: A new init retains the preceding nonprovisional final and clears its duplicate/conflict state; parse accumulates completed phase usages. The old three-init/full-final counterexample is source-addressed. Unproven no-init conflicting finals are not promoted to a new finding.

reviewedChanges.item: Empty zero followed by activity without final
reviewedChanges.assessment: An empty zero is provisional; subsequent activity clears it and missing final returns FINAL_MISSING. It no longer supplies a completed zero final for this sequence.

reviewedChanges.item: Error final zero preserves observed partial usage
reviewedChanges.assessment: Final token values below retained messages become a partial lower bound, with totalCost cleared. Existing saved signed partial test reports 1/1; it is not an independent rerun or full node lifecycle acceptance.

reviewedChanges.item: ExecutionRequest supervisor/grant and billing checkpoint fields
reviewedChanges.assessment: Formal request now includes supervisor, continuationGrant, project-supervisor purpose and unknown-history acknowledgement; checkpoint schema and runtime both allow nativeCliVersion and session-cumulative costScope.

Unknown is explicit, signed runtime accepts it, and journal ACK remains bound to delivery ID/run/kind/body SHA. Actual interrupted/startup HTTP-to-ACK recovery remains unverified; the formal incoming usage DTO issue is A-R6-01.

reviewedChanges.item: Grant result hash, unknown history and old task token boundary
reviewedChanges.assessment: Supervisor and grant source hashes now share JSON.stringify. API requires explicit acknowledgement of unknown history, persists and propagates it to request, and preflight lets a bound single-round grant use its independent token window even when task history is unknown or over the old limit. Claim and local pump both use that preflight. The grant window still has its intended 10M maximum; this is not the old history gate.

Runtime and agent metadata use 20261017-cc-supervisor-r43-r3. Author report explicitly says no new packages, releaseReady false, no deployment or agent upgrade. Old R5 candidates do not establish a matched R6 deployable pair.
